auth_methods.quote: OAuth is required for multiple accounts, while static auth access tokens are used for installing in a single account at a time.
auth_methods.note: Static auth token is sent as Authorization: Bearer; developer hapikey is only for app-management endpoints.

credential_access.quote: Developer test accounts are free HubSpot accounts with access to a 90-day trial of many enterprise features
credential_access.note: Free developer test accounts and free standard accounts; static-auth private app token is self-serve.

production_gate.note: Two readings. (1) marketplace_listing: in the new developer platform distribution=private allows max 10 allowlisted accounts; wider distribution uses distribution=marketplace, listing needs >=3 active installs and review. (2) none: docs say marketplace 'eligible for listing', and public OAuth apps historically install on any account without listing. Docs read do not state whether an unlisted marketplace-distribution app can install beyond 10 accounts. Best guess: none (listing optional).

api_type.quote: HubSpot developer projects and REST APIs are versioned based on when they were released.
api_type.note: No GraphQL API found in the llms.txt docs index (CMS GraphQL for HubL not counted).

mcp_official.quote: HubSpot offers two distinct MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers
mcp_official.note: Remote server https://mcp.hubspot.com and local developer MCP server, both run by HubSpot.

main_blocker_type.quote: You can create up to 10 test accounts to test apps and integrations without affecting any real HubSpot data.
main_blocker_type.note: Free signup, standard OAuth, official MCP; no major obstacle.
